response.sql: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS avg_per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_per_day) AS avg_across_ratings FROM rating_averages) SELECT AVG(r.avg_per_day) AS avg_per_day, AVG(r.avg_per_day - o.avg_across_ratings) AS avg_excess FROM rating_averages AS r CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE r.avg_per_day > o.avg_across_ratings
